reading.body:
Adobe reported $23.8 billion in annual revenue as of November 2025 and operates four commercial-use AI products across image, video, and audio generation, all trained on commercially safe data.

The company has moved AI from research into production across its core creative suite. Adobe Express AI and Adobe Firefly handle image generation. Premiere Pro AI extends this to video with generative tools for content extension and color matching. Adobe Podcast AI covers audio enhancement. Each product emphasizes commercial safety in training, a positioning that reflects Adobe's customer base of professional and enterprise users who require legal clarity on training data provenance.

This portfolio reveals how AI embeds into existing software infrastructure rather than replacing it. Adobe does not appear to offer foundation models or standalone inference services. Its AI features integrate into licensed design and video tools that already consume power and compute resources. For data center operators, this means AI workloads added to products customers already use, not new categories of demand.

The data does not cover compute spend, energy consumption, model size, or Adobe's infrastructure footprint. It does not reveal whether Adobe trains models in-house or relies on third parties. California legal exposure registers at 175 instances, but no specific disputes are documented here.

profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, traded on Nasdaq under the ticker ADBE. The company reported revenue of $23,769,000,000 for the fiscal year ending November 28, 2025, per its most recent 10-K filing. Its website focuses on Adobe Express, which the company describes as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool for creating social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe tracks several AI products across creative categories. Adobe Express AI is positioned as a lightweight design tool with quick content creation features and integration with Adobe Firefly, the company's image generation product, which Adobe describes as trained on commercially safe data. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video editing with features including generative extend and color match, and Adobe Podcast AI handles audio enhancement and speech processing. Adobe describes all four products as built on commercially safe training data.

The held facts show 181 legal cases with California exposure on record for Adobe, though no individual case details are provided in the current data. Adobe holds a verified page on this site and carries CIK 0000796343 with the SEC.
